app.name: Wii64 | glN64 GFX | WiiVC
app.long_description:
Wii64 1.8.3 (WiiVC version with glN64 GFX Plugin) Wii64 is a port of Mupen64 0.5.1 to the Wii/GameCube By Monty Perrotti, based on Wii64 by the Wii64 Team (tehpola, sepp256, emu_kidid)
This specific version is for the Wii VC mode on Wii U specifically. See the guide on how to properly run this.
It currently runs most games at full speed or close to it, there are some known graphical and/or core issues. Please see the enclosed README and visit https://github.com/Monsterray/Wii64 to report issues, or to check out the latest progress.
Special Thanks to: Wii64 Team - the original Wii64 Extrems - Not64/libogc2 drmr - Graphics marshallh - Wii64 Demo ROM wiibrew - wiki & forums shagkur/WinterMute - libogc/devkitPPC Team Twiizers for Wii homebrew GLideN64 gonetz and others
Wii64 and the Wii64 logo are trademarks of the Wii64 Team and should not be used in unofficial builds.
